description: Add function exposure management to the Data API settings page alongside the existing table controls. Create a unified interface where users can grant/revoke EXECUTE permissions on database functions through a toggle UI, with proper grouping of function overloads and clear empty states.
functional_requirements: Add a function selector component to the Data API settings page that displays available functions grouped by schema.name (combining overloads into single toggleable entries)
Implement toggle controls that grant/revoke EXECUTE permissions on all overloads when toggled, with visual indication for functions in unexposed schemas
Update the existing save mutation to handle both tables and functions in a single API call, maintaining backward compatibility with existing table controls
Display appropriate empty states when no functions are available ('No functions available') instead of showing '0 of 0' counts
Ensure the UI only displays normal and window functions (excluding triggers and aggregates) and properly dims/unclicks functions from unexposed schemas
Update count labels to reflect both table and function exposure counts after saving changes
